title: A Logarithmic Cone of Prime Differences: An Expository Experiment on the Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function
description: The matrix of differences p_j − p_i of the primes opens like a cone, the Prime Number Theorem written geometrically. We subtract the cone and ask whether its residual carries the oscillations predicted by the explicit formula of Riemann and von Mangoldt. It does. We report the full path: negative and positive controls, two pitfalls found and corrected, and a pre-registered confirmation on 16 previously unexamined zeros that met two of its three criteria and failed the robustness test on half-windows.
